summary: Traverses component hierarchy or a prefiltered input list to output one table row per operator matching family, type, path, parameter, comment, tag, DAT-content, or callback criteria.

common_gotchas: Deep hierarchy searches can be expensive; generated diagnostics should set depth or maximum-operator bounds when possible.
Incremental cook mode spreads search work over frames and may output partial results until traversal finishes.
An input DAT can seed search roots, but its first column must contain operator ids generated by OP Find's ID column.
Case sensitivity applies across all pattern criteria, so mixed path/tag/name searches need one consistent matching mode.
Callback filters should be pure predicates; mutating the searched hierarchy while searching can destabilize results.
key_concepts: Traverses a component hierarchy and outputs one row per operator matching selected criteria.
Component, depth, family, and operator-count parameters bound the search space.
Filter parameters match names, types, paths, comments, tags, DAT text, and parameter names/values/expressions.
Column toggles and callbacks customize the result table and allow custom output columns.
